mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approvals( leave_id, approver_id, step_no, status ) VALUES( #{leaveId}, #{approverId}, #{stepNo}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT lv.id AS leaveId, us.name AS applicantName, lt.name AS leaveTypeName, lv.start_date AS startDate, lv.end_date AS endDate, lv.created_at AS createdAt FROM approvals ap JOIN leaves lv ON ap.leave_id = lv.id JOIN users us ON lv.applicant_id = us.id JOIN leave_types lt ON lv.leave_type_id = lt.id WHERE ap.approver_id = #{approverId} AND ap.status = 'PENDING' AND ap.step_no = ( SELECT MIN(step_no) FROM approvals ap2 WHERE ap2.leave_id = ap.leave_id AND ap2.status = 'PENDING' ) ORDER BY lv.created_at DESC

SELECT lv.id AS leaveId, us.name AS applicantName, lt.name AS leaveTypeName, lv.start_date AS startDate, lv.end_date AS endDate, lv.reason AS reason, lv.status AS leaveStatus, lv.created_at AS appliedAt FROM approvals ap JOIN leaves lv ON ap.leave_id = lv.id JOIN leave_types lt ON lv.leave_type_id = lt.id JOIN users us ON lv.applicant_id = us.id WHERE lv.id = #{leaveId} AND ap.approver_id = #{approverId} AND ap.status = 'PENDING'
